name: veqtor-workspace-pilot
description: Pilot: edit project documents with model-written Python, automatic task snapshots and a DOCX check.
long_description: Select the folder containing your documents. Each editing task snapshots the latest saved file under a hidden .veqtor/ folder, edits a private copy and saves back to the same path after checking for conflicting changes. Python can read the project and write only task copies; no network. check_docx reports preservation findings and checks not performed. It does not certify legal wording, layout or native Word behavior. Save Word changes before starting a task.

workspace.title: Document project folder
workspace.description: Folder containing the actual documents. Task snapshots stay in its hidden .veqtor/ subfolder. When updating from 0.0.4, select the document folder here.

author.title: Tracked-change author
author.description: The name written into new tracked changes and comments.

tools.name: workspace_info
tools.description: List the protected input copies, outputs, author and the short editing recipe.

tools.name: document_task
tools.description: Snapshot the latest file, save after conflict checks, or inspect the outcome of an interrupted save.

tools.name: run_python
tools.description: Run Python: project and task snapshot read-only, task work/ writable, no network.

tools.name: check_docx
tools.description: Compare a DOCX result with its original: defects, compatibility warnings and checks not performed.
